permission.intro: Pixo needs these permissions to record the clipboard, place the quick panel beside the text field, and receive the keyboard. It adds itself to the list in System Settings. You have to turn each switch on.
permission.restart: If a switch is on but still shows as needed here, quit Pixo completely and open it again.
permission.accessibility: Places the quick panel beside the current text field, receives keys while it is open, and pastes a chosen item back into the app you were using.
permission.inputMonitoring: Lets the quick panel receive keystrokes while it is open.
permission.pasteboard: Records copies in the background. In System Settings, set Pixo to Always Allow.

json.description: Format, compact, and check JSON data.
json.invalid: Invalid JSON. Check your input and try again.
json.copyError: Could not copy. Please copy the result manually.

clipboard.description: Keep text, images, and file paths on this computer so you can copy them again.
clipboard.settingsDescription: Choose what to record, how long to keep it, and the shortcut for the quick panel. Changes are saved automatically.
clipboard.privacy: History stays on this computer and is never uploaded. You can review what is stored, and where, before turning it on.
clipboard.empty: Nothing here yet. Copied items will show up after you turn history on.
clipboard.panelHint: Copied. You can paste it now.
clipboard.panelHelp: Arrow keys choose an item. Enter copies and closes. {{option}}+Enter pastes it back. {{option}}+Shift+Enter pastes plain text. {{command}}+number copies that item, and {{option}}+number pastes it. {{pin}} pins it and assigns a shortcut that copies it while search is empty. {{remove}} deletes it. Esc closes the panel.
clipboard.panelHelpSelect: Click or press Enter to copy and close. Hold {{option}} and click, or press {{option}}+Enter, to paste back into the previous app. {{option}}+Shift+Enter pastes plain text. {{command}}+number copies that item, and {{option}}+number pastes it. Arrow keys move and copy. {{pin}} pins an item and assigns a shortcut that copies it while search is empty. {{remove}} deletes it. Esc closes the panel. Hold {{option}}+Shift while clearing to remove pinned items too.
clipboard.panelHelpPaste: Click or Enter pastes the item back into the previous app and closes the panel. Hold {{option}} to copy only. {{plain}} pastes plain text. Arrow keys move and copy. {{command}}+number copies that item, and {{option}}+number pastes it. {{pin}} pins an item; with an empty search, its key pastes it. {{remove}} deletes it. Esc closes the panel.
clipboard.copyOnSelect: Applies in the quick panel. Arrow keys copy the selected item without closing or moving it. When Paste automatically is off, click and Enter copy and close.
clipboard.pasteAutomatically: Clicking an item or pressing Enter pastes it back into the previous app and closes the panel. Hold {{option}} to copy only, and {{option}}+Shift to paste plain text. Arrow keys still only copy.
clipboard.enableBody: Pixo stores copied text, images, and file paths locally, and skips content the system marks as sensitive. You can pause, delete, or clear it at any time.
clipboard.cleared: Unpinned items were cleared. Pinned items remain.
clipboard.clearedAll: All items were cleared, including pinned items.
clipboard.clearConfirm: Clear unpinned items? Pinned items stay.
clipboard.clearAllConfirm: Clear every item, including pinned items?
clipboard.pasteNeedsAccess: Copied. Accessibility access is required to paste it back into the previous app.
clipboard.pasteUnsupported: Copied. Automatic paste is unavailable here, so paste it yourself.
clipboard.hintPasteAccess: Without Accessibility access, the item is still copied and explained here.
clipboard.waylandShortcut: This Wayland session cannot register a global shortcut. Open the quick panel with pixo --clipboard-panel.
clipboard.skippedTooLarge_one: Skipped {{count}} item over the size limit.
clipboard.skippedTooLarge_other: Skipped {{count}} items over the size limit.
clipboard.skippedExcluded_one: Skipped {{count}} item from an excluded app.
clipboard.skippedIgnored_one: Skipped {{count}} item matching an ignored type.
clipboard.fileMissing_one: {{count}} file is no longer at its original path. The list was still copied.
clipboard.fileMissing_other: {{count}} files are no longer at their original paths. The list was still copied.
clipboard.maxItems: Older unpinned items are removed after this many. Pinned items stay.
clipboard.retentionZero: Use 0 to keep items until the count limit removes them.
clipboard.excludedHelp: One app identifier per line. It must match the source shown on an item exactly.
clipboard.excludedPicker: Choose from the apps installed on this computer. Copies from a selected app are not recorded.
clipboard.excludedLimit: You can exclude up to 100 apps.
clipboard.excludedWayland: This Wayland session cannot identify the source app, so this exclusion list has no effect.
clipboard.ignoredTypes: One clipboard type per line. Matching copies are not recorded. Passwords and temporary copies still follow Skip sensitive content. Add com.apple.is-remote-clipboard to ignore Universal Clipboard.
clipboard.macosAccess: Opening Pixo asks for these system permissions. For the clipboard, choose Always Allow in System Settings.
clipboard.shortcutHelp: Click the field and press the new shortcut. Esc cancels. Include Command, Control, Option, or Shift. If the shortcut cannot be registered, this change is not saved.
clipboard.pinShortcut: Pins or unpins the selected item in the quick panel and the history list.
clipboard.deleteShortcut: Deletes the selected item immediately in the quick panel. The history list asks for confirmation first.
clipboard.shortcutNeedModifier: Press it together with a modifier key.
clipboard.kindDisabled: This kind of content is turned off in settings.

statusReason.wayland_no_data_control: This Wayland session does not offer a clipboard monitoring protocol.
statusReason.no_display: No usable display session was found.
statusReason.platform: Clipboard monitoring is unavailable on this platform.

error.unsupported: This action is not available in the current environment.
error.busy: The clipboard is busy. Try again in a moment.
error.too_large: The content is over the size limit.
error.file_missing: The original file no longer exists.
error.storage: The local history could not be saved.
error.shortcut_conflict: That shortcut could not be registered.
error.needs_confirm: This change deletes existing items and needs confirmation.
error.desktop_only: Clipboard history is available in the Pixo desktop app.
error.unknown: The action did not finish. Try again.

system.trayIcon: Shown in the menu bar at the top of the screen.
system.autostart: Start Pixo automatically when you sign in.
system.background: Keep Pixo running after closing the window. On macOS, hide the Dock icon and use the menu bar to reopen or quit.
system.clipboardFeature: Turning this off stops clipboard history and its shortcut, and hides Clipboard in the left menu. Turning it on asks for confirmation first.
system.screenshotFeature: Turning this off stops the screenshot and recording shortcuts, the menu bar can no longer start a capture, and Screenshot is hidden from the left menu and from Settings.
system.sshFeature: Turning this off disconnects open SSH sessions and hides the sidebar entry.
system.dockerFeature: Turning this off disconnects open Docker connections and hides Docker in the left menu. You can turn it on again in Settings.
system.versionHelp: The version comes from this installation. Releases take their version from the GitHub tag, and this check compares it with the latest release.
system.updatePrompt: You are using {{current}}. The latest version is {{latest}}. Download and install the new version.
system.updateAvailable: Version {{version}} is available. Install it to update.
system.upToDate: This is the latest GitHub release.
system.updateError: Could not reach GitHub to check for updates.
system.error: Could not update the setting. Check system permissions and the menu bar icon, then try again.
system.desktopOnly: General settings are only available in the Pixo desktop app.
system.theme: Use light, dark, or follow the system.
system.language: The language used in the interface.

screenshot.description: Freeze the screen, then choose screenshot or screen recording at the top. After the selection, choose MP4 or GIF. The file is written to your save folder only when you download it.
screenshot.settingsDescription: Choose the shortcut, save folder, and whether Pixo hides itself. Choose Record at the top of a capture, then MP4 or GIF. Changes are saved automatically.
screenshot.desktopOnly: Screenshots are available in the Pixo desktop app.
screenshot.local: Screenshots and recordings are not uploaded. A recording stays out of your save folder until you download it. Copying follows your clipboard history settings.
screenshot.wayland: This Wayland session cannot capture silently.
screenshot.permission: Allow Pixo to record the screen before taking a screenshot.
screenshot.relaunch: macOS saved the permission. Quit and reopen Pixo, then try again.
screenshot.ocrHelp: After you select an area, choose Extract text on the toolbar. Recognition stays on this computer. The result is shown so you can copy it.
screenshot.ocrUnsupported: Text extraction is not available on this system.
screenshot.ocrNeedSelection: Select the area to read first.
screenshot.cardCapture: Freeze the screen and select any area to annotate, pin it on screen, copy, or save.
screenshot.recordLater: After you start a capture, choose Record at the top. When the selection is done, pick a format in the selection and start. Download puts the file in your save folder. Close discards it.
screenshot.recordEntry: After you start a capture, choose Record at the top. When the selection is done, pick a format in the selection and start. Download puts the file in your save folder. Close discards it.
screenshot.recordHint: Select the area to record. Then choose the format and pointer effect inside the selection.
screenshot.audioUnavailable: The speaker or microphone could not be opened. Allow Pixo to use the microphone, and make sure system audio can be recorded.
screenshot.cameraFailed: The camera could not be opened. Allow Pixo to use the camera in system settings.
screenshot.scrollModeHint: Scroll capture starts after the selection.
screenshot.scrollManual: Scroll up or down with the wheel inside the selection.
screenshot.scrollAutoOn: Scrolling down automatically. The wheel still works.
screenshot.scrollNeedSelection: Select a taller area before scroll capture.
screenshot.scrollNeedsAccess: Scroll capture needs Accessibility permission. Allow Pixo in System Settings, then try again.
screenshot.scrollStill: No new area was captured. Point at the scrolling content, use the wheel, and try again.
screenshot.libraryEmpty: Saved screenshots and downloaded recordings show up here.
screenshot.copiedNoHistory: Copied. The image is too large for clipboard history.
screenshot.displayChanged: The displays changed, so this capture was cancelled.
screenshot.truncated: Only the first 8 displays are shown.
screenshot.hideSelf: Hide Pixo’s windows when a shortcut or the menu bar starts a capture.
screenshot.recordShortcut: Press it to open the screen with Record already selected, then drag a selection.
screenshot.saveDir: The default folder is Pixo inside Pictures. Choose folder opens the file manager. Downloaded images and recordings are written here.
screenshot.scrollHeight: The stitched image will not exceed this height.
screenshot.scrollAuto: When on, scroll capture moves the page down by itself. When off, scroll inside the selection yourself.
screenshot.shortcutHelp: Focus the field and press a new combination. Esc cancels. Include Command, Control, Option, or Shift.
screenshot.shortcutNeedModifier: Press it together with a modifier key.
screenshot.settingsInvalid: These screenshot settings can't be saved.

error.unsupported: This action is not available in the current environment.
error.busy: A capture is already in progress.
error.not_found: That pin could not be found.
error.storage: The image could not be saved.
error.invalid_input: That annotation could not be saved.
error.shortcut_conflict: That shortcut could not be registered.
error.pin_limit: The screen already has 8 pins. Close one first.
error.desktop_only: Screenshots are available in the Pixo desktop app.
error.too_large: This image is too large for the clipboard.
error.unknown: The action did not finish. Try again.

intro.body: Press {{shortcut}} to open the clipboard. The shortcut works from other apps after Accessibility is allowed. Screenshot, recording, hosts, and Docker appear in the menu bar icon's right-click menu when those tools are turned on.
intro.needAccessibility: Accessibility access is still off. Allow Pixo in System Settings, then open the panel.
intro.needScreen: Screen recording is still off. Allow Pixo, then try the screenshot again.
intro.actionFailed: That step did not finish. Read the message above and try again.

ssh.description: Connect to a remote host, open a terminal, and move files between the current directory and this computer.
ssh.enableBody: Connections go only to hosts you add. Passwords and key passphrases are asked each time unless you choose to keep them in the system keychain. The first connection asks you to confirm the host fingerprint, and a changed fingerprint blocks the connection.
ssh.disableBody: Open sessions will disconnect, and the sidebar entry will be hidden.
ssh.desktopOnly: SSH is available in the Pixo desktop app.
ssh.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Saved fingerprints stay on this computer.
ssh.hostkeyUnknown: This is the first connection to this host. Confirm the fingerprint before continuing.
ssh.hostkeyChanged: The host fingerprint does not match the saved one, so the connection was blocked. This can be a server key change or a man-in-the-middle.
ssh.hostkeyRevoked: This host key is marked revoked, so the connection was blocked.
ssh.hostkeyUserFile: The record is in the system known_hosts file. Pixo does not change that file.
ssh.rememberHint: Saved in this computer’s keychain, so the next connection can sign in without asking.
ssh.keyringUnavailable: This computer has no keychain available, so passwords and passphrases are not saved.
ssh.agentHint: Uses a key from ssh-agent first. If the agent has none, Pixo tries the same passphrase-free default keys in ~/.ssh that the ssh command uses. Pixo does not store those keys.
ssh.agentForwardHint: Lets the remote host use this computer's ssh-agent. Turn this on only for hosts you trust.
ssh.keepaliveHint: Seconds. 0 turns it off. Applies to connections opened after the change.
ssh.deletePathBody: Folders are deleted with their contents. A link is removed without following it.
ssh.agentMissing: ssh-agent is not connected right now. Connecting will use a passphrase-free default key in ~/.ssh instead.
ssh.jumpsHint: Choose jump hosts in connection order. The first one is connected first, then each following host, and finally the target.
ssh.jumpInUseBody: {{hosts}} still use this host as a jump. Confirming removes those jump links and deletes it.
ssh.themeHint: Colors apply to the prompt, directory listings, and any colors a remote program sends. An existing colored prompt is left unchanged.
ssh.contrast: When text and the background are too close, separate them automatically.
ssh.scrollback: How many lines you can scroll back in the terminal.
ssh.confirmPaste: Ask before pasting text that contains line breaks, so it is not run on the remote host by mistake.
ssh.copySkipsHistory: Text copied from the terminal is not saved in clipboard history.
ssh.pasteConfirmBody: This text contains line breaks and may run on the remote host.
ssh.leaveHint: Press Command+Shift+E or Ctrl+Shift+E to move focus out of the terminal.
ssh.dropPending: Drop to upload to the current directory
ssh.dropNotReady: Wait until the connection is ready, then drop the files.
ssh.conflictTitle: A remote file already has this name
ssh.downloadConflictTitle: A local file already has this name
ssh.importHint: Only entries that point at one specific host are imported. Wildcards, port forwarding, and other unsupported settings are skipped. A selected host is imported together with the jump hosts named in this file.
ssh.importDuplicate: A host with the same address, port, and user already exists, so it starts unchecked.
ssh.importJumpMissing: The jump host is not in this file, so the imported host has no jump.
ssh.importIdentityMissing: The private key file is missing right now. The path is still kept.
ssh.forwardHelp: The local port listens only on this computer and connects to an address the current host can reach. Forwarding stops when the session disconnects.
ssh.snippetHelp: Save commands you use often and send them to the current session.

error.not_found: That host or session could not be found.
error.storage: The local settings could not be saved.
error.connect_failed: Could not connect to this host.
error.resolve_failed: Could not resolve the host name.
error.hostkey_rejected: The host fingerprint was not accepted.
error.hostkey_changed: The host fingerprint changed, so the connection was blocked.
error.key_unreadable: The private key could not be read. Check the file and passphrase.
error.keyring_unavailable: The system keychain is unavailable, so the password was not saved.
error.port_in_use: That local port is already in use.
error.forward_limit: A session can forward at most 8 ports.
error.snippet_limit: You can save at most 100 snippets.
error.sftp_unavailable: This host does not provide SFTP, so files cannot be transferred.
error.remote_permission: You do not have permission to access this remote path.
error.remote_missing: The remote path does not exist.
error.local_permission: You do not have permission to access this local path.
error.token_expired: This selection expired. Choose or drop the files again.
error.disk_full: There is not enough space, so the transfer stopped.
error.too_many: You can transfer at most 20,000 files at once.
error.jump_cycle: These jump hosts form a loop, so they cannot be saved.
error.jump_in_use: {{hosts}} still use this host as a jump.
error.config_unreadable: The SSH config could not be read.
error.transfer_failed: This file was not fully transferred.
error.desktop_only: SSH is available in the Pixo desktop app.
error.unknown: The action did not finish. Try again.

docker.description: Manage Docker or Podman engines as named connections. Certificates and passwords stay on this computer.
docker.enableBody: You can then connect to a local or remote engine and view containers, images, networks, and volumes. Connections stay on this computer.
docker.disableBody: This disconnects open engines and hides the sidebar entry. Saved connections are kept and can be turned on again in Settings.
docker.desktopOnly: Docker is available in the Pixo desktop app.
docker.emptyEndpoints: No connections yet. Detect a local socket, or import Docker contexts you already have.
docker.sshOff: The SSH tool is off, so this connection is unavailable.
docker.openFailed: The browser could not be opened.
docker.selectEndpoint: Choose a connection on the left.
docker.emptyCompose: No Compose projects were recognized. Create or import a compose.yaml, or refresh after a project has been started on the engine.
docker.composeDirectoryHint: Directory on the connected server. docker-compose.yml is stored here, and Compose uses it as its working directory.
docker.forgetCompose: Remove {{name}}? Containers that are already running stay as they are.
docker.composeDownConfirm: Clean {{name}}? This stops and removes its containers and networks. Volumes and the compose file stay.
docker.composeDeleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? This stops and removes its containers and drops the project from the list. The compose file stays.
docker.forceConfirm: {{name}} is still running. Force remove stops it first.
docker.insecureHelp: The Docker API on port 2375 is not encrypted. Others on the same network may be able to control this engine.
docker.socketHelp: Leave this empty to use the first local socket Pixo finds.
docker.remoteSocketHelp: Unix socket of the remote engine. Change it for rootless Docker or Podman.
docker.sshRequired: Save the host in the SSH tool first, then choose it here.
docker.contextInsecure: Plain TCP. The warning stays after import
docker.contextSsh: No matching SSH host. Save the same user and address in the SSH tool first
docker.contextDuplicate: An equivalent connection is already saved

error.unreachable: The engine could not be reached. Check the socket, address, or SSH host.
error.permission_denied: You do not have permission to access this engine.
error.tls: The certificates could not be used. Check the CA, client certificate, and key.
error.insecure_required: Confirm the risk before using a plain TCP port.
error.ssh_disabled: The SSH tool is off, so this connection cannot be used.
error.conflict: The container is still running. Force remove to continue.
error.in_use: That item is still in use and was not removed.
error.registry_auth: This image requires a registry login. This version does not store registry passwords.
error.not_compose: That file is not a Docker Compose file.
error.compose_exists: This directory already has a docker-compose.yml.
error.compose_dir: That directory does not exist and could not be created.
error.compose_path_unsupported: This connection cannot place the file on the server. A local socket or SSH can.
error.sftp_unavailable: This server does not provide SFTP, so the Compose file cannot be written there.
error.compose_cli: The docker command was not found. The project file is already saved.
error.compose_start_failed: The project was created, but it did not start. You can start it later from this directory.
error.compose_down_failed: The project was not cleaned up.
error.compose_file_missing: The compose file for this project was not found.
error.compose_logs_failed: The logs could not be read.
error.compose_start_unsupported: An SSH connection cannot be started from here. The project file is already in the selected directory.
error.busy: Too many logs or pulls are open. Close one first.
error.resolve_failed: The SSH host name could not be resolved.
error.hostkey_changed: The host key changed, so the connection stopped.
error.hostkey_rejected: The host key was not trusted.
error.key_unreadable: The private key could not be read.
error.storage: The local record could not be saved.
error.desktop_only: Docker is available in the Pixo desktop app.
error.unknown: The action did not finish. Try again.
